'''Thisspias''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]]. It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Cygnat/Legends|cygnats]] and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasians]]. The Thisspiasians were governed by a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-old absolute [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] that was complemented by a [[Democracy/Legends|democratically]] elected parliament. The Thisspiasians, an ancient species of warriors, joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, becoming instrumental in averting both external and internal threats to that government. Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], the planet fell within the borders of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].

The Thisspiasian [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Thisspias in [[206 BBY]] and was given to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as an [[Youngling/Legends|infant]]. After Rancisis inherited the title of [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of Thisspias in [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]], he abdicated the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] in favor of continuing his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training and eventually became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Thisspias remained undecided on its loyalty to either the Republic or the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], although Rancisis was instrumental in securing the aid of Thisspiasian warriors to Republic's side in several of the conflict's battles.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Thisspias was [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] and its inhabitants were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. The [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Thisspias)/Legends|Imperial governor]] of the planet [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] the [[Crown prince of Thisspias|Thisspiasian crown prince]] and subdued a [[Thisspias insurrection|native insurrection]]. Ultimately, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] liberated the [[Crown/Legends|crown]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]], after which Thisspias was placed under Imperial military quarantine. The crown prince returned to reclaim the throne of Thisspias following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]; however, the desire of the populace for a more democratic government led to an extremely [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] [[Thisspias civil war|civil war]]. The Blood Monarch returned to power, and the planet was a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. The [[Thisspias system/Legends|Thisspias system]] was [[Battle of the Thisspias system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Thisspias was a rocky<ref name="UAA" /> and [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urbanized]]<ref name="AotCIllustratedCompanion" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="UAA" /> located in the [[Thisspias system/Legends|Thisspias system]], a part of the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA Thisspias" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The landmasses on the planet were green-[[Color/Legends|colored]] with brown-and-white [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] areas. Thisspias also featured pink and blue natural reservoirs of liquid,<ref name="NEGAS" /> and the planet's climate was [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]].<ref name="UAA" />

Thisspias was home to several types of small [[Species/Legends|creatures]] such as [[Bird/Legends|birds]], [[Insect/Legends|bugs]], and [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> In addition, the creatures known as [[Cygnat/Legends|cygnats]] lived on Thisspias.<ref name="Expanded" /> At some point, a [[Thisspiasian precursor species|species]] of [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]], [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] also lived on the planet. The species eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasians]]. The [[Plant/Legends|flora]] of Thisspias included plants that bore [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
===Early member of the Republic===
During the early period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] existence, the Thisspiasians, an ancient species of [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] warriors native to Thisspias, eagerly joined the fledgling government,<ref name="NEGAS" /> with Thisspiasian warriors helping the Republic overcome many internal and external threats<ref name="UAA" /> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nikil Nobil]] holding a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="FatalAlliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="3643 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', during which [[Nikil Nobil]] is a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], to approximately [[3643 BBY]].</ref>

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Thisspias was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the Republic at some point between [[8000 BBY]] and [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], and by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the Thisspias [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the widely explored territory known as the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], Thisspias fell within the borders of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA Thisspias" />

===Home of a Jedi Master===
[[File:OppoRancisis_egtf.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Thisspias was the homeworld of Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis.]]
In [[206 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] was 174 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and that he was twenty when [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|his sister]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Ratamesh. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Rancisis must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[206 BBY]] and the events on Ratamesh must have occurred in [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]].</ref> the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Thisspiasian [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to the [[Oppo Rancisis's mother|reigning Blood Monarch]] of Thisspias.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The Blood Monarch turned her [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] son over to the Jedi Order, hoping that Rancisis would return to Thisspias upon completing his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] and use it to strengthen the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]].<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> By [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Rancisis' [[Parent/Legends|mother]] had [[Death/Legends|died]] and the [[Crown/Legends|crown]] had passed to his [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|younger sister]].<ref name="FF126">{{FactFile|126|OPP 1-2|Oppo Rancisis}}</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], agitators [[Storming of the Thisspias alcazar|stormed]] the [[Thisspias alcazar]] on the astronomical object [[Ratamesh]] and killed Rancisis' sister, who was present at the structure at that [[Time/Legends|time]]. As a result, the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of Thisspias was inherited by Rancisis, although he abdicated in favor of continuing his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training, eventually becoming a Jedi Master.<ref name="PotJS" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Thisspias remained within space controlled by the Republic,<ref name="TEA Thisspias" /> and the Republic's [[Eleventh Army]] was tasked with defending the planet's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the first campaigns of that conflict.<ref name="EGTW" /> However, by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Thisspias was undecided on its affiliation to either the Republic or the Confederacy.<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

At one point in the conflict, Rancisis requested that the [[Unidentified Blood Monarch|reigning Blood Monarch]] of Thisspias help the Republic fight against the Separatists. Per the Thisspiasian tradition, the Jedi Master had to defeat the [[Blood Monarch/Legends|ruler]] in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] in order for the former's request to be fulfilled. When Rancisis triumphed in the duel, the Blood Monarch agreed to lend Thisspiasian warriors to several battles of the Clone Wars.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===An oppressed world===
Thisspias became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the planet, and the Thisspiasians were conquered and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. The [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Thisspias)/Legends|Imperial governor]] appointed to rule over Thisspias [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] the reigning Blood Monarch and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] the Thisspiasian [[Crown prince of Thisspias|crown prince]] in the planet's [[Imperial troops' headquarters]]. The resultant [[Thisspias insurrection|insurrection]] by the outraged, rebellious Thisspiasians was quickly put down by the superior firepower of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

Shortly after that, [[Spy/Legends|spies]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] infiltrated the Imperial facility housing the captive Thisspiasian crown [[Prince/Legends|prince]] and liberated the heir. The humiliated [[Governor/Legends|governor]] threatened to [[Speciecide|annihilate]] the Thisspiasian species but was eliminated by an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> one of a number of secret personal assassins of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="CSWE Emperors Hand">{{CSWECite|I|232-3|Emperor's Hand}}</ref> who was sent to punish the governor for his failure. Although several of the natives of Thisspias left the planet and joined the Rebel Alliance, their homeworld was subsequently subjected to a<ref name="NEGAS" /> planet-wide<ref name="UAA" /> military quarantine<ref name="NEGAS" /> and remained under Imperial rule until shortly after Palpatine's death at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="UAA" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===Post-Empire===
The crown prince of Thisspias returned to his homeworld at that point. However, his claim to the throne was opposed by a vocal portion of Thisspiasians, who desired a transition to a more [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government. The dispute led to a brief yet extremely [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] [[Thisspias civil war|civil war]] that saw the Blood Monarch's return to power.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Subsequently, the new monarch took the first steps toward his homeworld joining the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="UAA" /> and by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Thisspias fell within the borders of that government.<ref name="EGTW" />

The Thisspias system was [[Battle of the Thisspias system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The system remained under the invaders' [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] between 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA Thisspias" /> At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Thisspias was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the galaxy that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Thisspiasian-NEGAS.png|thumb|right|200px|The Thisspiasians were native to Thisspias.]]
Thisspias was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Thisspiasians, a sentient species of [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] reptiles with four arms and a serpentine, prehensile tail.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The Thisspiasians spoke the [[Thisspiasian (language)/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="UAA" /> The population of Thisspias numbered between 100 million and 500 million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA Thisspias" /> The homeworld of the Thisspiasians was ruled by an absolute monarchy that remained unchanged for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]. The position of Blood Monarch was hereditary, although a democratically elected parliament<ref name="NEGAS" /> deals with most matters of state,<ref name="UAA" /> including much of the planet's legislation.<ref name="NEGAS" />

Many<ref name="UAA" /> inhabitants of Thisspias believed that the monarchy was degenerate and corrupt, and tied to archaic customs that were irrelevant in the modern times.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Although the monarchy took periodic strides toward catching up with changing realities,<ref name="UAA" /> during the reign of the New Republic and its successor, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Thisspiasians had become convinced that the planet's leadership had undergone very little evolution, continuing to practice a decadent lifestyle and remaining tied to antiquated [[Politics/Legends|political]] traditions.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarWarsEpisodeIWhosWhoAPocketGuideToCharactersOfThePhantomMenace-cover.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Thisspias was introduced in ''Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace''.]]
Thisspias was first mentioned in the [[1999]] book ''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]'', which was authored by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Ep1WhosWho">''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> The first visual depiction of Thisspias was on a [[2001]] map of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' galaxy designed by [[James King]] and [[Laurence Butler]] and included with the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 1|first issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine.<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile|1|[[:File:Galaxymap3.jpg|Galaxy Map Poster]]}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Thisspias system, and therefore Thisspias itself, in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA Thisspias" />

In ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="NEGTC" /> and published on [[April 23]], [[2002]],<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news20020212.html|text=Book Preview: The New Essential Guide}}</ref> the preposition "in" is used in conjunction with the proper name "Ratamesh" when providing context for the Thisspias alcazar, suggesting that they were both locations on Thisspias.<ref name="NEGTC" /> In the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook<ref name="PotJS" /> published in [[August]] 2002,<ref name="Amazon">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020815cpreview&c=rpg|text=Take a Look Inside: A Preview of the ''Power of the Jedi Sourcebook''}}</ref> most of the wording regarding Ratamesh from ''The New Essential Guide to Characters'' is kept, except the preposition "on" is used, suggesting instead that it was an astronomical object separate from Thisspias. This article assumes the latter source is correct.<ref name="PotJS" />
